question: Which of the following is the official language of Afghanistan?
solution:
The correct answer is **Dari**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Dari** is one of the two official languages of Afghanistan, the other being Pashto.
 
• Dari is a variety of the Persian language and is also known as Afghan Persian.
 
• It is widely spoken by about half of the population of Afghanistan.
 
• Dari serves as the lingua franca in Afghanistan, facilitating communication among different ethnic groups.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
 

 Option
 Details
 
 

 Option 1 (Sinhala)
 Sinhala is the official language of Sri Lanka.
 
 

 Option 2 (Burmese)
 Burmese is the official language of Myanmar.
 
 

 Option 3 (Dari)
 Dari is one of the two official languages of Afghanistan.
 
 

 Option 4 (Dzongkha)
 Dzongkha is the official language of Bhutan.
